image_dir.ask: Folder on the SmartSEM PC the grabbed TIFFs are written to
image_dir.help: A local path on the microscope PC (the API writes the file there); share it if agents elsewhere need the images.

pump_timeout_s.ask: Seconds to wait for a pump or vent before the job is failed

smartsem.ask: SmartSEM Remote API ProgID, member, parameter and command names (JSON object), from the API reference
smartsem.help: Every shipped name is a placeholder; correct them from ZEISS's SmartSEM Remote API reference (or the SmartSEM API Test application) before the first hardware test.
